oneOf.description: Source, library, own-playback and engine requests (step 2).

Conflict.description: An Ossicle position conflict. `conflict.resolve` keeps one position.

id.description: Opaque to the face; pass it back as `library.open` node.

Item.description: One library, search or queue entry. Unknown fields stay absent.

count.description: Child count of an album, playlist, show or group.

oneOf.description: One summary per configured source, in the order Pyxis, Ossicle, Jellyfin.

Output.description: A Pyxis output ("Play on"): this computer or a remote device.

OwnPlayback.description: The active source's session: Pyxamp playing here, or driving a remote output.

note.description: A short display note such as "SKIPPED SPONSOR".

Page.description: The answer to `library.open` or `search`, sent before the request's result.

positionMs.description: Resume position of a part-played item.

QueueItem.description: One queue occurrence. The same item can occur twice with different occurrences.

albumKey.description: Equal keys on consecutive rows fold into one album-mode row (Ossicle: the show).

attempt.description: 1 after the first failure, 2 after the second.

nextAtMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

own.description: The active source's session, if any.

player.description: The followed foreign MPRIS player (step 1 meaning, unchanged).

systemVolume.description: The default audio sink's volume; absent when unknown (no PipeWire, no default sink).

oneOf.description: List a source's root groups (node absent) or a group's or item's children.
Search every ready source; one merged page.
Play or enqueue. Playing from another source pauses the old one, keeping its place.
Save the active queue as a new playlist.
Set the default audio sink's volume (the system volume), 0..1 on wpctl's scale.
EQ and balance change Pyxamp's own audio only.

SourceId.description: The three sources. Wire tags are the jump-box source tags in lower case.

groups.description: First-level groups exactly as the source reports them, in its order.

Yielded.description: Own playback paused by a foreign player.

resumeByMs.description: Wall-clock deadline for automatic resume; absent means it stays paused.
